accepted_static_contracts: Explicit linked 13 count cases times 3 anchors yields exactly 39 scenarios; fixed shapes are literal, not computed by production planner.
Literal left/center/right orders for column counts 1 through 5 match baseline reorder policy; bottom-first logical row mapped to physical row traversal.

Actual production PopupKeyboardUi roots measured under bounded AT_MOST constraints and laid out; child rectangles use parent-relative coordinates and actual dimensions, not requested LayoutParams alone.
Every occupied actual child is traced to exactly one AutoScaleTextView; token membership/uniqueness/complete coverage, literal cell position, direct trigger identity and reachability are asserted.
Space detection does not require visibility: physical slots are checked with parent-relative rectangles, INVISIBLE state and actual non-clickable/non-focusable flags.
Direct focus activation uses actual cell top plus 85 percent height, correctly preserving the existing row bias; it makes no claim about geometric center behavior.
n5 and n10 legacy Y goldens independently match rowCount - roundToInt(y / keyHeight - 0.2), clamp and dismissal bounds, including unchanged full-grid mismatch at center.
Only ASCII single-letter tokens are used; helper does not invoke Rime, execute actions, write preferences, create native session or claim a real input-device path.
Actual installed sourceDir and SHA-256 are captured; parsed theme comes from installed APK assets, with theme bytes hash recorded.
Private UUID output directory, bounded image dimensions, bitmap recycle finally, bounded report size and manifest-write error affecting instrumentation exit are present.
Soft 140 second interrupt, 150 second hard finish and main task await bounds are explicit; cleanup failures force passed=false.
Prior logical theme/scheme are restored through public API when a prior scope existed, without writing the two observed theme preferences; null-prior limitations are explicitly recorded.

required_root_adjudication.detail: The baseline expected flag requires two known regression signatures but is not a whitelist of all failures. Before accepting baseline, independently inspect all violations and require unchanged controls (especially initial_focus, legacy_y_policy_changed, outside_did_not_dismiss and dismiss_callback_count) to have no unexpected failures. The flag alone is insufficient.
Helper records actual installed APK hash but does not accept or verify an expected hash. Root must compare it with the frozen baseline/candidate APK and source binding and enforce expect identity.

When old scope was null, logical_scope_cleanup_completed remains false and process_scope_reset_required true. The helper may pass the fixed grid nevertheless. Root must actually stop the isolated target process after collection and verify stopped identity before any other acceptance stage.

An already-running main Runnable cannot be interrupted. A hard-deadline result is failure and does not establish cleanup completion. Root must stop any process left after failure and never count partial matrices as passed.
preferences_unchanged compares normal_mode_color and follow_system_day_night only. No claim about every application preference byte is justified by this field alone.
Unattached production View measurement/draw and direct method invocation do not establish InputDispatcher/IME long press, physical device, TalkBack, native input or Chinese text acceptance.
